profile.headline: Founder & Financial Advisor @ Trusted Path Wealth Management, LLC | Fee-Only | Fiduciary | Lead Software Engineer @ Williams-Sonoma, Inc.
profile.summary:
I work full time as a Software Engineer and am also the Founder of Trusted Path Wealth Management, LLC, where I help individuals and families make confident financial decisions. I combine analytical thinking with a deep passion for financial planning, tax-efficient investment management, and long-term strategy to guide clients toward clear, long-term financial goals.

My interest in investing began at an early age, inspired by my father’s lessons about diversification and long-term thinking. That foundation, along with earning my MBA and starting my investment journey in 2008 (including through the 2009 financial crisis), shaped my disciplined, long-term, and tax-aware approach to planning and investing.

I founded Trusted Path to provide independent, fiduciary, fee-only guidance, meaning I work solely for my clients without ties to banks, or product providers. I’m not restricted to recommending any particular company’s funds or products. This independence allows me to focus entirely on what best serves each client’s unique needs, including optimizing decisions for after-tax outcomes. I’m compensated 100% by my clients, with no commissions or sales incentives. My advice is objective and personalized, built on integrity and care.

Whether you’re looking to organize your finances, invest wisely using tax-efficient strategies, plan for retirement, build a legacy, or incorporate philanthropy into your financial strategy, I work with clients to design a plan that reflects their values and aspirations.

If you’re ready to bring clarity and confidence to your financial life, I’d love to connect.
